name: @lazily-hub/lazily-js
description: Native JavaScript port of the lazily reactive core: a full reactive graph (Cell/Slot/Signal/Effect), sync/async/thread-safe keyed reactive maps (ReactiveMap/SourceMap/ComputedMap), the lazily-spec IPC wire types + C-ABI FFI boundary (isomorphic channel + Node native binding), keyed cell collections + LIS reconciliation, the memoized semantic tree, the move-aware sequence CRDT, the Fugue/RGA text CRDT, manufactured text identity, full-Harel state charts, an FFI state-projection consumer, and an in-library instrumentation/benchmark API.

scripts.generate:protobuf: mkdir -p build/generated && pbjs -t static-module -w es6 -o build/generated/graph-boundary.js ../lazily-spec/proto/lazily/graph_boundary/v1/graph_boundary.proto && pbts -o build/generated/graph-boundary.d.ts build/generated/graph-boundary.js
scripts.build: npm run generate:protobuf && node --check src/index.js && node --check src/msgpack-codec.js && node --check src/transport.js && node --check src/shm-backend.js && node --check src/reactive.js && node --check src/teardown-scope.js && node --check src/reactive-async.js && node --check src/reactive-family.js && node --check src/async-reactive-family.js && node --check src/thread-safe.js && node --check src/thread-safe-reactive-family.js && node --check src/ffi.js && node --check src/ffi-node.js && node --check src/instrumentation.js && node --check src/state-machine.js && node --check src/statechart.js && node --check src/collections.js && node --check src/queue-core.js && node --check src/queue.js && node --check src/thread-safe-queue.js && node --check src/async-queue.js && node --check src/merge.js && node --check src/relay.js && node --check src/ingress-core.js && node --check src/ingress.js && node --check src/thread-safe-ingress.js && node --check src/async-ingress.js && node --check src/rateshape.js && node --check src/membership.js && node --check src/coordination.js && node --check src/presence.js && node --check src/windowing.js && node --check src/resilience.js && node --check src/service.js && node --check src/temporal.js && node --check src/stdlib.js && node --check src/sem-tree.js && node --check src/stable-id.js && node --check src/seq-crdt.js && node --check src/text-crdt.js && node --check src/indexeddb-outbox.js && node --check src/utf8-offsets.js && node --check src/lossless-tree-crdt.js && node --check src/state-projection.js && node --check src/graph-view.js && node --check src/signaling.js && node --check src/distributed.js && node --check src/protobuf-graph-boundary.js && node --check build/generated/graph-boundary.js && node scripts/update-size-limits.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:formal && npm run test:size && LAZILY_CONFORMANCE_MANIFEST=build/conformance-fixtures-loaded.txt LAZILY_CONFORMANCE_KEY_MANIFEST=build/conformance-assertion-keys.txt LAZILY_CONFORMANCE_BLOCK_MANIFEST=build/conformance-assertion-blocks.txt LAZILY_CONFORMANCE_SCENARIO_MANIFEST=build/conformance-scenarios.txt sh -c 'mkdir -p build && : > "$LAZILY_CONFORMANCE_MANIFEST" && : > "$LAZILY_CONFORMANCE_KEY_MANIFEST" && : > "$LAZILY_CONFORMANCE_BLOCK_MANIFEST" && : > "$LAZILY_CONFORMANCE_SCENARIO_MANIFEST" && node --require ./test/support/conformance-manifest.cjs --test test/*.test.js'
